Plugin.Name: shive
Plugin.Overview: Scheduled ZFS snapshots with age or GFS (hourly/daily/weekly/monthly) retention per location, optional Docker container quiesce/resume around the snapshot, replication to a second local pool and/or an SSH host, and a WebGUI snapshot browser with file/folder/dataset restore and disaster recovery. A failed backup never leaves a container down: the resume is anchored on an EXIT trap and backed by a crash-recovery pass. Pruning only ever touches a schedule's own snapshots, and every destructive action requires explicit confirmation.
